blocks.text:
After breakfast, we will go to Abismo Anhumas, located 20 km west of Bonito, which is like a trip to the center of the Earth! This is a 72-meter chasm that ends in an underground lake, where incredible stalactite formations live. The first part of the exercise is a descent of 5 meters through a narrow gap in the ground.

Then the chasm is getting wider, and a giant crater opens up under your feet: a 72-meter descent leads to a crystal-clear lake where you can go snorkeling. In addition to the amazing experience of descending into one of the largest underwater caves in Brazil, this is a very exclusive experience: only two groups of eight people descend per day.
